We ask to select the most readable and the least readable summaries among three displayed summaries. For informativeness, we instruct annotators to mark the least informative and the most informative summary.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on controllable text summarization with fine-grained readability control. It evaluates three main methods: instruction-based prompting (CATEGORYINSTRUCT, SCOREINSTRUCT), reinforcement learning (SCOREINSTRUCT+RL), and lookahead decoding (SCOREINSTRUCT+LA). The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric names and model variants.
